title: Invoices
footnote: Invoices are edited from their job card. Pending payments confirm automatically after the clearance window.

resend.noEmail: This customer has no email address on file — add one on the job card's Customer Details tab first.

void.reconstructionNote: The original line snapshot was destroyed by an admin unlock, so the retained lines are rebuilt from the job card as it stood.
void.confirmIntro: Voiding does not delete anything. This is what will be kept:
void.keepNumber: Invoice number {{number}} — kept, exactly as issued
void.keepTotal: The total, {{total}} — kept on the document
void.keepLines: All {{count}} line(s) — kept, frozen as they are
void.keepConsumed: {{number}} stays consumed. It is never reused, and the sequence keeps the gap — which is why the reason above matters.
